newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares maintain upward trend in quiet week.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares maintain upward trend in quiet week.

text.p: Shares on Qatar's unofficial stock market maintained their upward trend despite low activity in the week to Thursday, dealers said.
The 18-share Commercial Bank of Qatar index inched up to 120.70 points from a previous 120.35.
Five shares advanced and 13 remained unchanged.
Commercial Bank of Qatar senior investment manager Mazin al-Shakarchi said it had been a quiet week, but some shares "did show increased demand".
Market leader Qatar National Bank moved up two riyals to 587 and Al Ahli Bank of Qatar also gained two riyals to 212.
Qatar Navigation and Qatar Cement rose five riyals each to 695 and 295 respectively.
Qatar Flour Mills gained five riyals to 300.
Qatar announced on Saturday that it would open an official stock exchange in the first quarter of 1997.
